frGuideQuickAnswerMismatch.note: 167 is the exact manifest-driven count (all guides-cluster pages, all 3 languages); supersedes CONTENT-06's manually-sampled ~50/55 estimate with an exhaustive figure

englishLeakage.checkedScope: all ES/FR HTML pages, against a controlled list of 5 known English-only literals

rootCause.defectA: buildQuickAnswer() decided guide-vs-generic treatment via two English/Spanish-prefix-convention regexes (rel path, H1 text). French guide titles are phrased as statements, not questions, so only 8/58 FR guide pages matched either heuristic; 50/58 fell through to a generic silo-level answer describing the wrong content type.
rootCause.defectB: The <40-word branch of buildQuickAnswer() unconditionally appended a hardcoded English sentence regardless of page language.

testFailBeforeEvidence: git stash of only the source file caused a hard SyntaxError (missing export LEARNING_ONLY_SUFFIX) rather than a soft assertion failure - the pre-fix module could not satisfy the test file's imports at all
decision: Both defects fixed at source, proven via before/after tests and two new permanent validators; exactly 61 pre-identified pages repaired with zero unrelated changes.
nextPart: CONTENT-07 Part 2 (not started): evidence-selected second editorial pilot batch from the 66 quantified B1 candidates - a separate, explicit decision.
